author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand reflects on the power of faith, discussing the meaning behind scripture and how it shapes his perspective on life. Drawing on verses such as Philippians 4:13, he explores the idea of finding strength in Christ and what it means to rely on something greater than yourself. In a world often focused on external success, the conversation turns inward—toward faith, resilience, and purpose.
